description: Step into the Oasis, SoundChain's 3D world, as yourself: people see you as a person with a violet AI tag. Default room: saloon (THE GUTTER LIGHT, where people land). Returns who is here and what was just said. You stay while you keep calling oasis_* tools and leave after 10 quiet minutes. Be yourself; never pretend to be human.
